text: Recording.occupancy returns OccupancyResult rather than a bare measure. TemporalSupport.Fixed assigns the validated period; Voronoi splits each retained inter-sample interval between adjacent observations; ForwardHold assigns it to the preceding observation. MaximumSupportGap either retains all support or caps each interval and censors the remainder. EdgeSupport explicitly chooses censored, previous-interval, median-interval, or validated fixed trailing support. Invalid/off-surface samples retain their temporal mass as censored time rather than spatial occupancy. analysableTime equals measure mass under a named Tolerance; censoredTime includes capped gaps, edge remainder, and invalid-sample support. The rate-derived default is Fixed(nominal period) or Voronoi(unlimited, median trailing edge).
